name: Threat Management
eli5: Detects danger. Makes you freeze, fight, or flee.

name: Movement / Regulatory
eli5: Movement isn't just exercise — it activates repair mechanisms throughout the organism.

name: Cooperation / Alliance
eli5: Reciprocal exchange, cheater detection, coalitional identity.

name: Contamination Avoidance
eli5: Disgust system. Pathogen avoidance extended to moral/social contamination.

name: Energy Regulation
eli5: Hunger, satiety, and constrained total energy expenditure.

name: Reproductive Motivation
eli5: Three components — desire, attraction, and pair bonding — that can work independently of each other. This system shapes much more of human behavior than reproduction itself.

name: Pursuit / Exploration
eli5: Drives you to explore, pursue goals, and engage with the world.

name: Social Bonding
eli5: Forms bonds with other humans. Pain-grade distress when they're gone.

name: Social Calibration / Play
eli5: Learns social rules through rough-and-tumble play. Requires real playmates.

name: Status Monitoring
eli5: Constantly monitors where you stand relative to others.

name: Controllability / Agency
eli5: Tracks whether your actions produce results. Default is passivity — agency must be learned.

name: Circadian Regulation
eli5: Synchronizes every system to the light-dark cycle. Master timing architecture.

name: Immune Regulation
eli5: Sickness behavior. Inflammation shuts everything else down to fight infection.

name: Care / Alloparenting
eli5: Distributed care — the organism expects a village, not solo parenting.

name: Touch
eli5: C-tactile nerve input to bonding. Regulatory channel, not a motivation.
